body_markdown:
**Wednesday, Aug. 12**


TDS service is now fully restored in Spokane. Customers who lost service during this outage will receive a bill credit for the time they were offline. We also know that some customers sustained major property damage, including loss of their home or business, and may need to discuss their TDS service further. If you have any questions or concerns, please chat with us online or call us at (888) 225-5837 so we can help.


**Monday, Aug. 10**


TDS techs are working through customer tickets to identify outage causes to individual homes. Crews are also repairing damaged aerial fiber and restore service to more areas. If commercial power is restored to your home, but internet service is still down (and you have tried resetting your modem), please call our customer support line at 1-888-225-5837.


**Friday, Aug. 7**


Crews continue to uncover damage and repair the core elements of the network. As more areas are brought back online, technicians are going door-to-door to restore TDS service to individual homes wherever possible. Impacts from smoke and high fire risk may impact restoration efforts over the weekend.


**Thursday, Aug. 6**


Multiple TDS crews are on the ground in Spokane today completing ground and aerial repairs. A portion of customers have already been restored, and crews are aiming to bring a large number of additional customers back online today and tomorrow. There is concern for increased fire risk over the weekend, so repairs will be dependent on evacuation orders and safety information from first responders.


A vac truck has been brought in to remove melted network elements to install new ground vaults and repair fiber cable.


**Wednesday, Aug. 5**


The ongoing wildfires in Spokane are having a devastating impact on the community. TDS extends our sympathy to all those affected and our sincere gratitude to first responders. The fires impacted some TDS infrastructure, and crews are now assessing damage to our network and completing repairs wherever possible. Work is underway on the core elements of our network in the fire-damaged area and will then move to the surrounding areas as access is expanded. Check out photos of the fire damage and our techs hard at work below.


Although we are moving forward with restoration and have brought many customers back online, know we are also closely monitoring changing weather conditions and fire risk in our service areas. Our crews prioritize safety and follow all local guidelines while completing repairs. In some cases, repair processes are dependent on third-party partners completing their work before TDS.


Updates on repair progress and service restoration will be posted to our[TDS outage page](https://tdstelecom.com/support/outage.html) . Customers will also be receiving an email with information on bill credits for their time without service. Credits will be automatically applied to accounts after service is restored. If your service was impacted and you do not see a credit on your current or next bill, please contact our support team via chat or phone. Depending on your billing cycle, credits may appear on a subsequent statement.


If commercial power is restored to your home, but internet service is still down, please call our customer support line at 1-888-225-5837. As always, our online chat is available 24/7 in the lower right-hand corner of our website to assist customers with questions or concerns.

Kelly is an associate manager of communications for TDS Telecom and is based in Missoula, MT. Before starting her career in local news, she earned a bachelor’s degree from Central Saint Martins College in the United Kingdom. She has also worked in nonprofit communications and event management. A lifelong animal lover, Kelly shares her home with two dogs, a cat, and a bunny.
